inlines.v: CONFUSED, participle passive 1. Mixed; blended, so that the things or persons mixed cannot be distinguished. Some cried one thing, and some another; for the assembly was confused Acts 19:32. 2. Perplexed by disorder, or want of system; as a confused account. 3. Abashed; put to the blush or to shame; agitated; disconcerted.
